common.name: data
common.doc: Rows to draw. If omitted, the demo dataset is rendered (REQ-093): accessor props (`…Key`, `keys`, `names`, `levels`, `axis`, `dimensions`, `period`, `nodes`) are ignored, every other prop applies.

common.name: ground
common.doc: Style ground. Defaults to the app provider's, or `silverpoint`.

common.name: substrate
common.doc: Prepared substrate within the ground (REQ-046).

common.name: mode
common.doc: `ink` by default; `precision` disables inking (REQ-021).

common.name: palette
common.doc: Colours over the ground's, field by field, written on the root's `style` (REQ-461). Merged over the dashboard's and the provider's (REQ-462); presets are on `@silverpoint/core/palettes`.

common.name: seed
common.doc: Seed. If omitted, it is derived from `id` stably (REQ-003).

common.name: id
common.doc: Stable identifier. If omitted, it is generated deterministically.

common.name: height
common.doc: Height of the drawing area in px. Width is the container's unless pinned.

common.name: chrome
common.doc: `card` draws the full frame; `bare` only the drawing area (REQ-095).

common.name: hatchFill
common.doc: How areas are filled (REQ-029).

common.name: label
common.doc: Accessible name. If omitted, it is derived from `title` (REQ-120).

common.name: description
common.doc: Long description for screen readers (REQ-120).

common.name: dataTable
common.doc: Tabular alternative; `hidden` leaves it for assistive technology only (REQ-121).

own.name: series
own.doc: `all` draws the secondary series when there is one; `primary` omits it.

own.name: connectNulls
own.doc: Whether a gap left by a missing value is bridged (REQ-008).

own.name: scaleMax
own.doc: Value that maps to the darkest tone; 100 by default.

own.name: columnLabels
own.doc: Names of the columns, in order; missing ones fall back to `#k` (delta-006).

own.name: weeks
own.doc: Weeks shown, the most recent last; 26 by default.

own.name: step
own.doc: Where the step sits between two points; `after` by default.

own.name: rows
own.doc: Rows shown, from the first; all by default.

own.name: readoutKey
own.doc: The printed readout; the last value of the series by default. Ignored without `data`.

own.name: seriesKey
own.doc: The row's points: an array. Ignored without `data`.

own.name: pointKey
own.doc: The value of one point; the point itself when it is a number, else its `value`. Ignored without `data`.

own.name: metric
own.doc: The metric's name, printed under the figure.

own.name: delta
own.doc: Signed change, printed with its sign and a direction mark.

own.name: deltaTone
own.doc: Direction of the mark; from the sign of `delta` by default.

own.name: names
own.doc: Display names of the keys, in order; the keys themselves by default. Ignored without `data`.

own.name: baseKey
own.doc: An absolute total: the bar starts at zero and resets the running total. Ignored without `data`.

own.name: deltaKey
own.doc: A change from the running total. Ignored without `data`.

own.name: bounds
own.doc: Price bounds of the scale; derived from the data when omitted (REQ-097).

own.name: sizeRange
own.doc: Marker area in px², smallest to largest; `[60, 240]` by default.

own.name: sizeRange
own.doc: Circle area in px², smallest to largest; `[100, 500]` by default.

own.name: centerValue
own.doc: Printed in the centre; the total by default.

own.name: centerLabel
own.doc: A line under the centre value.

own.name: legend
own.doc: Names every sector with its share beside the ring; `true` by default.

own.name: domain
own.doc: The value range along a spoke; `[0, the largest value]`, niced, by default.

own.name: percent
own.doc: 0 to 100; saturated at the ends outside it.

own.name: caption
own.doc: Names the measure under the readout.

own.name: readout
own.doc: Printed in place of the percent.

own.name: percent
own.doc: 0 to 100; saturated at the ends outside it.

own.name: caption
own.doc: Names the measure under the readout.

own.name: readout
own.doc: Printed in place of the percent.

own.name: startAngle
own.doc: Where the first sector starts, in degrees clockwise from 12 o'clock; 0 by default.

own.name: bearingKey
own.doc: Where the wind blows from, in degrees clockwise from north. Ignored without `data`.

own.name: valueKey
own.doc: The wind speed; 0 is a calm, which has no direction. Ignored without `data`.

own.name: bins
own.doc: Ascending speed thresholds that split each sector; `[5, 10, 15, 20]` by default.

own.name: rings
own.doc: Rings shown, from the inside out; all by default.

own.name: indexRing
own.doc: The ring whose segment is brought under the index, 0-based; 0 by default. Without `data`, it addresses the demo’s rings: `Day`, `Shift`, `Team`.

own.name: indexValue
own.doc: The segment of `indexRing` under the index; its first segment by default. Without `data`, it addresses the demo’s rings: `Day`, `Shift`, `Team`.

own.name: maxCategories
own.doc: Categories drawn; past it the smallest merge into "Other" (`SP010`). 12 by default.

own.name: orbits
own.doc: Orbits shown, from the inside out; all by default.

own.name: markerKey
own.doc: A row's markers; `'markers'` by default. Ignored without `data`.

own.name: periodKey
own.doc: A marker's period, 0-1 over the cycle; `'period'` by default. Ignored without `data`.

own.name: bins
own.doc: A number asks for that many equal-width bins over the niced extent; an array gives the thresholds, increasing. Freedman–Diaconis by default, Sturges when the IQR is 0 (REQ-432).

own.name: cumulative
own.doc: Turns the counts into a running total.

own.name: groupKey
own.doc: Two groups at most are drawn. Ignored without `data`.

own.name: whisker
own.doc: Whisker reach as a multiple of the IQR; 1.5 by default (REQ-432).

own.name: outliers
own.doc: Draws the observations past the whiskers; `true` by default.

own.name: bandwidth
own.doc: Kernel bandwidth in data units, shared by every group; Silverman's rule by default.

own.name: quartiles
own.doc: Marks the quartiles inside each violin; `true` by default.

own.name: groupKey
own.doc: The group of an observation; one ridge per group. Ignored without `data`.

own.name: bandwidth
own.doc: Kernel bandwidth in data units, shared by every group; Silverman's rule by default.

own.name: overlap
own.doc: How far a ridge reaches into the one behind it, 0-1; 0.5 by default.

own.name: labelKey
own.doc: Names the point in the readout and the table. Ignored without `data`.

own.name: radius
own.doc: Point radius in px; 3 by default.

own.name: sort
own.doc: Order of the categories; `none` keeps the data order.

own.name: names
own.doc: Titles of the two values; `['start', 'end']` by default. Ignored without `data`.

own.name: endMarker
own.doc: `arrow` encodes the direction from the first value to the second.

own.name: orientation
own.doc: `rows` by default: long category names read across.

own.name: names
own.doc: Titles of the two periods; `['start', 'end']` by default. Ignored without `data`.

own.name: order
own.doc: `descending` gives rank 1 to the highest value (the default).

own.name: series
own.doc: Series drawn, the best-ranked first; all by default.

own.name: reference
own.doc: A reference value drawn as a dotted rule.

own.name: orientation
own.doc: `rows` by default, as a forest plot reads.

own.name: axis
own.doc: `date` reads ISO `YYYY-MM-DD` days in UTC; `number` by default. Ignored without `data`.

own.name: levels
own.doc: The level columns, most negative first. Ignored without `data`.

own.name: neutral
own.doc: Index of the neutral level, split across the centre; `null` for none. The middle one by default.

own.name: percent
own.doc: Normalises each row to 100 %; `true` by default.

own.name: arrows
own.doc: Draws direction marks along the path; `true` by default.

own.name: cells
own.doc: Cells in the grid; 100 by default.

own.name: valueKey
own.doc: Read on leaves; an internal node is the sum of its children. Ignored without `data`.

own.name: depth
own.doc: Levels drawn below the root; all by default.

own.name: rootId
own.doc: The node drawn as root, controlled (REQ-439); the data root by default.

own.name: valueKey
own.doc: Read on leaves; an internal node is the sum of its children. Ignored without `data`.

own.name: depth
own.doc: Rings drawn below the root; all by default.

own.name: rootId
own.doc: The node drawn as root, controlled (REQ-439); the data root by default.

own.name: dimensions
own.doc: The dimension columns, in axis order. Ignored without `data`.

own.name: domains
own.doc: Axis domains by dimension; derived from the data when omitted (REQ-097).

own.name: angleKey
own.doc: In the units of `period`. Ignored without `data`.

own.name: period
own.doc: One turn, in the units of the angle; when set, the line closes. Ignored without `data`.

own.name: startAngle
own.doc: Where the angle 0 sits, in degrees clockwise from 12 o'clock; 0 by default.

own.name: angleKey
own.doc: In the units of `period`. Ignored without `data`.

own.name: period
own.doc: One turn, in the units of the angle; 360 by default. Ignored without `data`.

own.name: binSize
own.doc: Bin size in px; 14 by default.

own.name: source
own.doc: `points` estimates a density from a point cloud; `grid` reads a regular grid of values.

own.name: levels
own.doc: A count of levels, or the thresholds, increasing: in the grid's values, or as shares of the density's peak. Ignored without `data`.

own.name: filled
own.doc: Fills the bands between levels; `true` by default.

own.name: scale
own.doc: Arrow length per unit of magnitude; fitted to the grid by default.

own.name: nodes
own.doc: The nodes, as data; the distinct ends of the links by default. Ignored without `data`.

props.name: id
props.doc: Stable identifier; seeds of unnamed charts derive from it (REQ-209). Required.

props.name: description
props.doc: Long description, exposed as the region's description (REQ-214).

props.name: ssrWidth
props.doc: Width in px used for nominal cell boxes on the server and at hydration (REQ-207). Default `1200`.

props.name: link
props.doc: Linked interaction (REQ-216); client entry points only.

props.name: ground
props.doc: Inherited by every chart inside, below the chart's own prop (REQ-212).

props.name: palette
props.doc: The section's colours, written on its root and merged under every chart's and component's own (REQ-462).

layout.name: columns
layout.doc: Columns per breakpoint. Default `{ sm: 1, md: 2, lg: 4 }` (REQ-208).

layout.name: rowHeight
layout.doc: Height of one row unit, in px, card chrome included. Default `240`.

layout.name: gap
layout.doc: Gap between cells, in px. Default `16`.

layout.name: cells
layout.doc: Cells in reading order (REQ-203). Omitted: every child, span 1.

cell.name: id
cell.doc: Matches `DashboardCell`'s `cell` prop; unique within the dashboard (REQ-205).

cell.name: colSpan
cell.doc: Default `1`. Clamped to the breakpoint's columns with `SP014` (REQ-204).

common.name: id
common.doc: The frame variant and every related id derive from it (REQ-307, REQ-329).

common.name: seed
common.doc: Overrides `id` for the frame variant only.

common.name: ground
common.doc: Style ground. Defaults to the dashboard's, then the app provider's, or `silverpoint` (REQ-311).

common.name: substrate
common.doc: Prepared substrate within the ground (REQ-046).

common.name: mode
common.doc: `ink` by default; `precision` disables inking (REQ-021, REQ-306).

common.name: palette
common.doc: Colours over the ground's, merged over the dashboard's and the provider's (REQ-461, REQ-462).

common.name: size
common.doc: Default `'md'`.

common.name: className
common.doc: Added to the component's root element, after its own classes.

own.name: variant
own.doc: Default `'default'`; `danger` also draws the exact ✕ glyph (REQ-310).

own.name: disabled
own.doc: Not focusable, not submitted; drawn with the disabled tone.

own.name: label
own.doc: Accessible name of an icon-only button (REQ-319).

own.name: block
own.doc: Fills the width of its container.

own.name: placeholder
own.doc: Hint shown while empty; not a substitute for the accessible name.

own.name: name
own.doc: Form field name; the native input submits under it (REQ-323).

own.name: readOnly
own.doc: Focusable and submitted, but not editable.

own.name: invalid
own.doc: Sets `aria-invalid` and draws the exact ⚠ glyph (REQ-334).

own.name: message
own.doc: Help or error text under the control, referenced by `aria-describedby` (REQ-334).

own.name: label
own.doc: Accessible name, when no `<label for>` names the control.

own.name: label
own.doc: The visible text and accessible name.

own.name: name
own.doc: Form field name; submitted as `on` when checked.

own.name: indeterminate
own.doc: Draws the exact dash and sets the native `indeterminate` state.

own.name: items
own.doc: The choices; each a native radio. Keys are unique (REQ-325).

own.name: name
own.doc: Required: the native radios submit under it (REQ-323).

own.name: label
own.doc: The visible text and accessible name.

own.name: name
own.doc: Form field name; submitted as `on` when on.

own.name: label
own.doc: Accessible name of the native range input.

own.name: name
own.doc: Form field name; the native input submits under it.

own.name: marks
own.doc: Values on the rail that get a labelled mark.

own.name: count
own.doc: Default `5`, in 1..10; each mark an exact lozenge.

own.name: name
own.doc: Form field name; the native radios submit under it.

own.name: readOnly
own.doc: Shows the value; the keyboard and the pointer do not change it.

own.name: items
own.doc: The options; each a native radio. Keys are unique (REQ-325).

own.name: name
own.doc: Form field name; the native radios submit under it.

own.name: block
own.doc: Fills the width of its container.

own.name: items
own.doc: The tabs; a disabled one is skipped by the arrows. Keys are unique (REQ-325).

own.name: label
own.doc: Accessible name of the tab list.

own.name: activation
own.doc: Default `'automatic'`: a tab is selected as focus reaches it.

own.name: items
own.doc: The steps, in order; a status is derived from `current` unless set.

own.name: title
own.doc: Heading of the card; without it the card is a plain container.

own.name: closable
own.doc: Adds a native close button; each adapter raises its close event.

own.name: closeLabel
own.doc: Accessible name of the close button. Default `Remove <text>`.

own.name: max
own.doc: Default `99`; above it the badge reads `99+`.

own.name: label
own.doc: Accessible text of the badge, e.g. `unread messages`.

own.name: text
own.doc: A caption set in the rule.

own.name: title
own.doc: Bold first line of the alert.

own.name: closable
own.doc: Adds a native close button; each adapter raises its close event.

own.name: closeLabel
own.doc: Accessible name of the close button. Default `'Close'`.

own.name: avatar
own.doc: Draws an avatar placeholder before the lines.

own.name: as
own.doc: The element, a lowercase HTML tag name. Default `'div'`.

own.name: name
own.doc: Adds the class `sp-<name>`, a lowercase ident.

own.name: frame
own.doc: Draws a frame of that kind.

own.name: tone
own.doc: Lays a tone: a level 1-4 of the ramp, or a state (`selected`, `primary`…).

own.name: columns
own.doc: The columns, in order; each names the key it reads from a row.

own.name: data
own.doc: The rows, drawn as given: the consumer sorts them (DD-040).

own.name: sortKey
own.doc: A sortable column's key; another key sorts nothing, silently.

own.name: rowKey
own.doc: The column whose value keys each row.

own.name: total
own.doc: The number of items paged over.

own.name: siblings
own.doc: Pages shown on each side of the current one. Default `1`.

own.name: items
own.doc: The last item is the current page.

own.name: src
own.doc: An image; the initials are drawn without one.

own.name: name
own.doc: The person's name: the accessible name and the source of the initials.

own.name: pixelSize
own.doc: Side length in px; the ground's control height when omitted.

own.name: trend
own.doc: Draws the exact ↑ or ↓ glyph beside the delta.

own.name: items
own.doc: The label–value pairs, a `<dl>`. Keys, when given, are unique (REQ-325).

own.name: title
own.doc: A heading above the list, at `headingLevel`.

own.name: accordion
own.doc: One item open at a time, natively (`<details name>`). Default `false`.

own.name: placeholder
own.doc: Hint shown while empty; not a substitute for the accessible name.

own.name: label
own.doc: Accessible name, when no `<label for>` names the control.

own.name: message
own.doc: Help or error text under the control, referenced by `aria-describedby` (REQ-334).

own.name: invalid
own.doc: Sets `aria-invalid` and draws the exact ⚠ glyph (REQ-334).

own.name: readOnly

own.name: maxLength
own.doc: The native limit; the counter shows it with `showCount`.

own.name: name
own.doc: Form field name; the native textarea submits under it (REQ-323).

own.name: min
own.doc: The lowest value; the value is clamped to it (REQ-485).

own.name: max
own.doc: The highest value; the value is clamped to it (REQ-485).

own.doc: Form field name; the native input submits under it (REQ-323).

own.name: title
own.doc: The heading, `${id}--title`, that names the dialog.

own.name: description
own.doc: A paragraph, `${id}--description`, that describes the dialog.

own.name: dismissible
own.doc: Escape and a backdrop click close it. Default `true`.

own.name: extent
own.doc: CSS length across the side. Default `'380px'` (start/end) or `'320px'` (top/bottom).

own.name: title
own.doc: A heading that names the popover.

own.name: text
own.doc: The tooltip, the trigger's accessible description.

own.name: items
own.doc: A string is its own key and label.

own.name: name
own.doc: Submits the key under this name, from a hidden input (REQ-323).

own.name: items
own.doc: Items, separators and labels, in order. Keys are unique (REQ-325).

own.name: label
own.doc: The menu's accessible name and the trigger's text when no trigger slot.

own.name: duration
own.doc: ms, at least 1000, or `Infinity`; the toaster's when omitted.

palette.name: substrate
palette.doc: The prepared ground the drawing sits on.

palette.name: ink
palette.doc: The main series and the frames of UI components.

palette.name: inkSecondary
palette.doc: The second series and the hatch of tones.

palette.name: heighten
palette.doc: White heightening on the live value (always outlined with `ink`).

palette.name: focus
palette.doc: Focus ring of UI components; `ink` by default.

timeline.name: data
timeline.doc: TimelineJS's JSON: a `title` slide, the `events`, optional `eras` and `scale`.

timeline.name: options
timeline.doc: TimelineJS options; `font` and `theme` are ignored, the skin sets both.

timeline.name: inkedFrames
timeline.doc: Lays the ground's frames and tones on TimelineJS's pieces (REQ-512). Default `true`.

timeline.name: card
timeline.doc: Frames the whole timeline as a card. Default `true`.

timeline.name: label
timeline.doc: The region's accessible name; the title's headline when omitted.
